sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: GROMACS：PME 分工與科學精度下的負載平衡
related.titleEn: GROMACS: PME partitioning under a scientific accuracy contract
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付事件時間線、年齡與截止餘裕、缺時戳拒絕案例及命令接受/作用完成的差異；只重播合成事件；請同學只使用交付件重算兩組，保留失敗案例與限制；全程使用合成檔案，不對生產系統執行故障。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the event timeline, age and deadline margins, missing-timestamp rejection case and command-acceptance versus completed-effect distinction. Replay synthetic events only, without issuing control commands to real hardware. Have a peer reproduce both configurations from the artifacts, retaining failed cases and limitations. Use synthetic files throughout; never inject these faults into a production system.
related.difference: 使用原創合成資料研究「GROMACS：PME 分工與科學精度下的負載平衡」，從物理或資料契約推導計算，並以反例驗證。完成：交付七種分工帳本、雙支線時間圖、精度比對及不可行分工的排除理由。
related.differenceEn: Investigate GROMACS: PME partitioning under a scientific accuracy contract using an original synthetic fixture. Derive the calculation from its physical or data contract, challenge it with a counterexample, and defend a bounded conclusion. Complete: Deliver a seven-partition ledger, branch timelines, numerical accuracy comparisons and explicit rejection reasons for unsupported decompositions, with all timing values labeled as synthetic.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課串行反應鏈時間為取得有效觀察延遲加控制排隊加致動完成時間；報告時間與每項 metric 時間需分開；有效觀察延遲 4 秒、致動 2 秒；控制排隊由 3 增為 10 秒；教學外部截止時間為 12 秒；名義式 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain；變更式 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
分別寫出 6/2 的 12、20 ms 與 4/4 的 18、10 ms；加 3 ms 後比較，而不是把支線時間相加。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The serial response chain adds delay to obtain a valid observation, control queueing and completed actuation time. Keep report time distinct from each metric’s timestamp and from receipt time. Valid-observation delay is 4 seconds and actuation takes 2 seconds. Control queueing changes from 3 to 10 seconds, against an externally specified teaching deadline of 12 seconds. Nominal 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain; changed 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Calculate PP and PME times separately for both allocations. Identify which branch determines each join, add the fixed exchange once, and compare the resulting times without summing concurrent branch durations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GADGET-4：加速度步長界與二進位時間階層
related.titleEn: GADGET-4: acceleration timestep bounds and binary time hierarchy

related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the event timeline, age and deadline margins, missing-timestamp rejection case and command-acceptance versus completed-effect distinction. related.differenceEn: Investigate GADGET-4: acceleration timestep bounds and binary time hierarchy using an original synthetic fixture. Complete: Deliver dimensional derivation, continuous-versus-scheduled timestep tables, an upward-rounding counterexample and a conservation-test plan that records the assumptions excluded from the simplified criterion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課串行反應鏈時間為取得有效觀察延遲加控制排隊加致動完成時間；報告時間與每項 metric 時間需分開；有效觀察延遲 4 秒、致動 2 秒；控制排隊由 3 增為 10 秒；教學外部截止時間為 12 秒；名義式 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain；變更式 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain。所有數值、限制與門檻為原創合成教學條件；來源支援概念與介面，不代表實機量測或設備規格。
計算基線界約 0.0158114，再平方回推；使用同一公式但不同算序作獨立核算。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: The serial response chain adds delay to obtain a valid observation, control queueing and completed actuation time. Keep report time distinct from each metric’s timestamp and from receipt time. Valid-observation delay is 4 seconds and actuation takes 2 seconds. Control queueing changes from 3 to 10 seconds, against an externally specified teaching deadline of 12 seconds. Nominal 4+3+2 = 9 s response chain; changed 4+10+2 = 16 s response chain. Every numeric input, limit and threshold is an original synthetic teaching condition. References establish concepts and interfaces, not measured machine results or equipment specifications.

Calculate the baseline bound near 0.0158114 and square it to recover the underlying ratio. Repeat the arithmetic in a different order, retaining intermediate units, to detect misplaced factors of two or an accidental squared softening length.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
